آجِلٌ Delayed; postponed; kept back; syn. مُتَأَخِّرٌ; [but in some copies of the K, for آجِلٌ, we find ↓ أَجِلٌ ;] as also ↓ أَجِيلٌ , of which the pl. is أُجْلٌ: (K:) and therefore, (TA,) not present; future; to come; contr. of عَاجِلٌ: (S, Msb, TA:)
and ↓ مُتَأَجِّلٌ , also, signifies delayed, deferred, or postponed, to the time of the end of a period; originally, contr. of مُتَعَجِّلٌ. (Mgh.) [See also أَجِيلٌ.] ―
-b2- [Hence,] الآجِلَةُ The [future,] latter, ultimate, or last, dwelling, or abode, or life; the world to come; syn. الآخِرَةُ; (K, TA;) contr. of العَاجِلَةُ. (S, TA.) ＝
-A2- Committing a crime; or a committer of a crime. (S, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
